LESSON: CONVERSATIONAL SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.8: Conversational Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Conversational Skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
